factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 3: Adjusted EBITDA decreased in all segments. Cargo harbours down EUR 1,864 thousand, Ferry down EUR 1,780 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Ferry profitability was pressured by higher fuel costs associated with higher diesel prices and more severe ice conditions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Adjusted EBITDA in the Ferry segment decreased despite higher revenue, as fuel costs increased due to both more severe ice conditions at the beginning of the year and significantly higher fuel prices.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group invested EUR 3.5 million, 70.6% less than in the prior-year period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Investments section: Investments in 2026 were EUR 3,529 thousand, compared to EUR 12,020 thousand in 2025, a decrease of approximately 70.6%.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow decreased to EUR 18.2 million from EUR 26.3 million, and cash ended the period at EUR 27.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Cash flows from operating activities were EUR 18,151 thousand (18.151 million) vs EUR 26,293 thousand. Cash and cash equivalents at 30 June 2026 were EUR 27,616 thousand (27.616 million).

factual_claims.claim: A EUR 19.2 million dividend was paid in May.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 10: 'In accordance with the resolution of the general meeting of 28 April 2026, the Group paid a dividend of EUR 0.073 per share, i.e. EUR 19,199 thousand in total... paid out to the shareholders on 20 May 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets were EUR 615.0 million, equity EUR 367.7 million and net debt EUR 145.8 million at period-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Financial Position: Total assets EUR 615,034 thousand, equity EUR 367,677 thousand, net debt (loans less cash) EUR 145,764 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Significant developments included new Terminal A and Terminal D detailed plans, a new potential EUR 32 million loan facility, additional summer ferry trips and Botnica’s North Sea charter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Significant Events section: Detailed plans for Terminal A and D approved, unsecured loan agreement for up to EUR 32 million, additional ferry trips ordered, Botnica's charter in the North Sea.
